//: Template for ~/.pi/agent/models.json — pi reads models.json from its own config dir,
NOT from the repo, so copy this there rather than pointing pi at this file:
Sized for a laptop RTX 5070 Ti (12 GB VRAM). See the VRAM budget table in
.claude/memory/cost-routing.md for the arithmetic behind these choices.
ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b     # 9.0 GB — all three tiers
ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b      # 4.7 GB — optional override
And set these before starting ollama:
export OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0      # halves KV cache; 14B needs it at 12 GB
export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1     # never hold two models at once
num_ctx is the setting that decides whether this fits. 14B at 16384 with a q8_0 KV
cache lands near 10.6 GB total. Raising it much past 20k spills into system RAM and
throughput collapses — watch `ollama ps` if generation suddenly crawls.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B (optional: full 32k context, lower quality)
